description:
A decision change that passed its gate and was written: the
`DecisionReport` kind.

duplicates.description:
Existing decisions the new one may repeat; the decision is written
anyway, because a person decides.

items.description: An existing decision a new one may repeat.

requirement.description: The first line of its requirement.

similarity.description: BM25 of the decision for the new text, from 0 to 1.

localPluginListed.description:
Whether `lighthouse.toml` lists the `local` plugin, without which the
project's own decisions do not run in `check`.

signals.description: The signals now recorded or linked, by id.

tested.description: What the gate ran before the decision was written.

failures.description: One line per failing example; empty when every example holds.

skipped.description:
One line per example that was not run because the program its command
check names is not installed; they are not failures.

unknownSignals.description: Signals the document names that the store does not hold.

title: DecisionReport
